body:

Sorry that the video is laggy I don't have the most impressive recording stuff. Anyways, I was recording this trying to get evidence of spicyhotdog, but instead found kayla_124.
You can ignore most of it, but I think the parts to focus on are :20-:25, :40-:47, and 1:05-1:10. Sorry that this is all I could really get
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i4fuNwp5Ojs&feature=youtu.be
That one is just kayla playing nebula. Sorry again for more lag; I don't know if any of this evidence is really good enough to prove it. (Also, be sure not to miss :35; you can see _Taipan falling to his death)
